name: episodic-cache-v3-bce-s44
description: Generate textual rule-retention/rule-change episodes and encode frozen-Qwen chronological feature caches (train+dev) [identifiable cyclic5/fixed-two v3]
command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
MODEL=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/qz/grouped_bce_4gpu_s44/v1/final
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
mkdir -p "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data" "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz"
cd "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish"
grep -q "cyclic5_fixed2_v3" harness/gen_text_episodes.py || { echo "STALE CODE: causal generator fix missing"; exit 9; }
"$V/bin/python" harness/gen_text_episodes.py --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/train.jsonl" --episodes 1024 --horizon 6 --rule-switch-prob 0.25 --seed 43
"$V/bin/python" harness/gen_text_episodes.py --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/dev.jsonl" --episodes 256 --horizon 6 --rule-switch-prob 0.25 --seed 3043
"$V/bin/python" harness/gen_text_episodes.py --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/test.jsonl" --episodes 256 --horizon 8 --rule-switch-prob 0.25 --seed 9043
"$V/bin/python" harness/build_episodic_features.py --input "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/train.jsonl" --model "$MODEL" --model-identity BCE_S44_FINAL --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/train.pt" --device cuda > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_v3_cache_train.log" 2>&1 || { echo "train cache failed"; tail -40 "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_v3_cache_train.log"; exit 3; }
"$V/bin/python" harness/build_episodic_features.py --input "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/dev.jsonl" --model "$MODEL" --model-identity BCE_S44_FINAL --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/episodic_data_identifiable_v3/dev.pt" --device cuda > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_v3_cache_dev.log" 2>&1 || { echo "dev cache failed"; tail -40 "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/episodic_v3_cache_dev.log"; exit 3; }
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
